chunks.text: From 22 September 2025 the main GST rates are 5% (merit rate) and 18% (standard rate), with a 40% rate for a short list of de-merit goods and services, and 0% for exempt supplies. The change followed the 56th GST Council decisions and Notification 9/2025-Central Tax (Rate).

The 12% and 28% rates were withdrawn for most supplies from 22 September 2025. Most goods that were at 12% moved to 5% and most goods that were at 28% moved to 18%. The old rates are needed only to verify invoices dated before 22 September 2025.

Gold, silver and platinum kept a 3% rate through the rationalisation. The 40% de-merit list covers items such as tobacco, pan masala, aerated and caffeinated sugary drinks, luxury cars, yachts, and betting and gaming.

The GST rate for a specific supply depends on its HSN code for goods or SAC code for services, and on conditions such as price thresholds. Confirm every code on the CBIC GST rate finder or the GST portal before billing.
